sources.snippet: Overview gte-multilingual-reranker-base is a reranking model developed by Alibaba-NLP that scores text pairs to determine relevance in multilingual retrieval scenarios. Built on an encoder-only transformer architecture, this 306M parameter model accepts up to 8192 tokens and supports over 70 languages.
